name: Mini Prime
description: A refined mini red-and-blue heroic robot companion with a more detailed cinematic mech silhouette, layered armor panels, matte metal materials, and calm powerful motions.

idle.purpose: calm resting, breathing, and blinking loop

waiting.purpose: waiting for approval, help, or user input

source.notes: A compact high-end virtual companion inspired by heroic red-and-blue cinematic truck-robot archetypes, without copying any specific character design: mini partner proportions, matte red chest and shoulders, deep blue limbs, layered silver mechanical torso, refined faceplate-like visor area, sharper segmented helmet silhouette, slim antenna-like side fins, articulated shoulder armor, beveled forearm and shin plating, visible panel breaks, clean mechanical seams, no logos, no readable symbols, no weapon, no extra decoration. More detailed and noble than a toy, but still readable at pet size.
